issues.what: the ring-surface view barely moves for about 180 frames; the near ring bands and the planet horizon hold almost the same layout, so there is little parallax and the view reads as a held still rather than flight over a surface with depth
issues.fix: add steady forward/lateral travel low over the rings so the near bands sweep past clearly faster than the planet limb, and add visible flow (particles, clumps, wakes) in the near ring material

issues.what: the camera goes from almost still at the end of terrain (3809) to fast motion with heavy ring blur by 3817-3823, and the framing swings hard by 3830; the speed ramp looks abrupt, with no sense of mass
issues.fix: ease out of the terrain hold over a longer ramp (roughly 20-30 frames) before the climb reaches full speed, and smooth the pitch/yaw change between 3823 and 3830

issues.where: near ring bands, lower left and center, all frames
issues.what: very fine, high-contrast radial lines in the ring texture are likely to crawl or shimmer during slow camera drift
issues.fix: prefilter/mip the ring band texture and add a small amount of temporal antialiasing or motion blur so the fine lines stay stable

issues.what: the Milky Way dust band brightens noticeably over a few sampled frames while the camera moves only a little, which may read as an exposure change rather than motion
issues.fix: keep background exposure constant through the dive and let the band enter only by camera rotation

issues.what: the motion blur on the rings is strong and looks smeared, not like a clean directional blur; check the full-rate frames for stepped ghost copies of the ring gaps
issues.fix: raise the motion-blur sample count for the rise so ring gaps blur smoothly
